record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare RAPID_SPIN: Phanpy (1 star) and Donphan (2 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (damage table index), atk (the buff base), range and maxPP. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage (raw 20/50/100/200 by the caster's stars) to the cast target, then gives the caster +DEF and +SPE_DEF of the same requested size, Math.round(0.5 x the caster's current atk at cast time), a value that grows with atk rather than a star table. The buff goes to the caster itself and is not conditioned on the damage result; AP/crit rounding and a held Big Eater Belt are applied afterwards by the stat adders (Twist Band cannot change a positive self buff).

targeting.who: damage: the cast target; buffs: the caster itself
targeting.note: The caster must reach its target (requiresTarget true). No area or secondary target. Which unit is chosen as cast target is decided by generic targeting code, which was not read.

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) because apBoost defaults to true; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); other damage multipliers inside handleSpecialDamage were not re-read for this record.
effects.resolution: applied (figure handed to PokemonState.handleDamage) = requested after those multipliers. handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1, and the target's shield absorbs first. takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp); 0 if the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce.

declaredRaw.formula: Math.round(0.5 x pokemon.atk), read at cast time from the caster's current atk
declaredRaw.label: requested DEF gain (raw, atk-scaled; no star table)

perUnitRaw.note: depends on the caster's atk at cast time; base class atk is Phanpy 6, Donphan 14 (before items, synergies, buffs), which would give 3 and 7 only if atk were unchanged

effects.scaling: requested = Math.round(0.5 x atk) (atk is the current value, so earlier atk buffs, items and bonuses count). PokemonEntity.addDefense with apBoost 1 then computes Math.round(requested x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit)); then Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down if the caster holds it (positive value); Twist Band does nothing (acts only on negative values).
effects.resolution: applied = the rounded/belted value added to the caster's current def (floor 0). Not permanent (permanent defaults to false), so it changes the in-fight entity only. Stacks additively on repeated casts; no cap seen. Because atk is read once before the two adders, the SPE_DEF gain uses the same requested value.

declaredRaw.label: requested SPE_DEF gain (raw, atk-scaled; no star table)

starBehavior.note: Only the damage table (20/50/100/200, fallback 200) is indexed by the caster's stars; the 3- and 4-star columns are not reachable by the two listed units' factory star counts (whether other mechanics raise stars was not examined). The buff has no star table: it follows the caster's atk.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP (floor 0), deals its damage again and adds another DEF and SPE_DEF gain on top (additive, within the fight); the amount is recomputed from atk at each cast.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 20 (1 star) / 50 (2 stars); DEF and SPE_DEF each +Math.round(0.5 x current atk). Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit multiplier, then reduced by the target's SPE_DEF with a minimum of 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is 0 when the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. Applied buff = requested after a second Math.round with AP and crit, then Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down) if held; Twist Band cannot apply to a positive self buff; the stat is floored at 0 by min(0). Final values additionally depend on untraced item and field effects. The shared-helper reference is knowledge core-mechanics.md section J; no heal, PP gain or shield is involved.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located

Damage resolution after handleDamage's earlier branches (e.g. Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, resurrection, passives, weather and field multipliers) was only partly read: protect, SPE_DEF division, minimum 1 and shield absorption were read; later death handling was not
unresolved: Order is damage first, then DEF, then SPE_DEF; atk is read once before the damage, so the damage cannot change it, but if the damage kills the target or triggers an on-death effect, effects keyed to that were not traced
The buffs are applied even if the damage was blocked (protect / skydiving / magic bounce): they are not conditioned on the damage result
The buff size depends on the caster's atk at cast time, which other mechanics (items, synergies, earlier buffs) change; those sources were not enumerated for this record
Helpers consulted: addDefense / addSpecialDefense, applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff and applyTwistBandBuff in pokemon-entity.ts were read (see evidence); no routing uncertainties are listed for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
